Technical Program Manager

Fictional Alder Infrastructure

FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION FOR APP TESTING

Coordinate a platform migration across engineering, security and operations without direct authority over every team.

REQUIRED

- Build dependency-aware plans and make risks and decisions visible.

- Define rollout readiness, escalation paths and measurable delivery outcomes.

- Resolve stakeholder conflicts and coordinate competing priorities.

- Understand technical tradeoffs sufficiently to ask effective questions.

- Track security review requirements with specialist owners.

NICE TO HAVE

- Basic SQL or reporting experience.

INTERVIEW STAGE

Hiring manager interview with situational program-delivery questions.
